title: FLUX kohya LoRA conversion crashes on `final_layer` (KeyError on missing adaLN_modulation_1; "Incompatible keys" on final_layer alphas)
author: christopher5106

comments.author: christopher5106
comments.body:
This also blocks the **ComfyUI / SwarmUI full-export** FLUX LoRA path on `main`, not just hand-written kohya LoRAs — worth noting since that's a very common export format.

Those exports carry `diffusion_model.final_layer.linear` **and** `diffusion_model.final_layer.adaLN_modulation.1` (so Case A doesn't fire), but they include `.alpha` for every module — so Case B does. On `main` (`0.39.0.dev0`) the ComfyUI branch correctly remaps `diffusion_model.*` → `lora_unet_*` and `text_encoders.clip_l.transformer.*` → `lora_te_*`, but conversion then fails on the unconsumed `final_layer` alphas, which also drags the otherwise-valid `lora_te_*` keys into the error message:

```python
# diffusers 0.39.0.dev0 (main), real ComfyUI FLUX LoRA export
FluxLoraLoaderMixin.lora_state_dict(comfy_state_dict)
# ValueError: Incompatible keys detected:
#   lora_unet_final_layer_adaLN_modulation_1.alpha, lora_unet_final_layer_linear.alpha,
#   lora_te_text_model_encoder_layers_0_mlp_fc1.alpha, lora_te_text_model_encoder_layers_0_mlp_fc1.lora_down.weight, ...
```

Dropping just the `final_layer` keys, the exact same export converts cleanly on `main` — confirming the ComfyUI mapping itself is fine and `final_layer` (this issue) is the sole blocker:

```python
comfy_no_final = {k: v for k, v in comfy_state_dict.items() if "final_layer" not in k}
sd = FluxLoraLoaderMixin.lora_state_dict(comfy_no_final)
# OK -> 988 transformer.* keys + 144 text_encoder.* keys
```

So fixing the `final_layer` alpha handling here would unblock the full ComfyUI/SwarmUI export as a side effect.

comments.author: christopher5106
comments.body:
A third `final_layer` converter issue in `_convert_sd_scripts_to_ai_toolkit`, distinct from the two above — flagging it here since it's the same code path.

`assign_remaining_weights` applies its `transform` (here `swap_scale_shift`) to **both** `lora_A` (down) and `lora_B` (up):

```python
for lora_key in ["lora_A", "lora_B"]:
    ...
    if transform:
        value = transform(value)   # applied to BOTH A and B
```

For the `final_layer.adaLN_modulation_1 → norm_out.linear` mapping that's wrong: the intended converted delta is `swap(B @ A)`, and since `swap_scale_shift` permutes the **output** axis, `swap(B @ A) = swap(B) @ A` — only the up tensor should be swapped. `lora_A` has shape `(rank, hidden)`, so swapping it permutes the **rank** axis and yields `swap(B) @ swap(A) ≠ swap(B @ A)`, silently corrupting the `norm_out` LoRA for any FLUX LoRA that trains the final-layer adaLN modulation (ComfyUI/XLabs full exports do).

Minimal numeric repro:

```python
import torch
from diffusers.loaders.lora_conversion_utils import swap_scale_shift
r, h = 4, 8
A = torch.randn(r, h)      # down (rank, hidden)
B = torch.randn(2*h, r)    # up   (2*hidden, rank)
assert torch.allclose(swap_scale_shift(B @ A), swap_scale_shift(B) @ A)        # intended, up-only  -> True
assert not torch.allclose(swap_scale_shift(B @ A), swap_scale_shift(B) @ swap_scale_shift(A))  # current -> mismatch
```

Fix: only transform the up tensor, e.g. gate it on `lora_key == "lora_B"` in `assign_remaining_weights` (`if transform and lora_key == "lora_B":`).

comments.author: lcheng321
comments.body: Fixed in https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers/pull/14001. All three cases addressed: KeyError, Incompatible keys, and swap_scale_shift on lora_A.
